title: Trans Salon - Scene 4
details:
A hairdresser, Kasey Kei, welcomes one of her favorite clients, Michael DelRay, who has come in for a trim. As they chat, it soon becomes clear that Michael has had a very stressful day. Kasey says she can tell that Michael is really tense, and she starts to give him a shoulder rub.

Michael clearly enjoys the extra attention, although he jokes that he didn't know a haircut comes with a massage. Kasey suggestively says that, just for him, she can give him even more stress relief. Michael gets the hint, and says he would love to relieve tension in that way. With that, they have hot sex to help Michael forget about all of his troubles!
